source.text_it: Il freno di soccorso interviene in caso di guasto del freno di servizio

records.localized_text: The emergency brake operates if the service brake fails.

source.text_it: In caso di eccessiva sovrappressione dell'aria dei serbatoi dell'impianto frenante, il conducente deve astenersi dall'utilizzare i freni e ricorrere maggiormente al rallentatore

records.localized_text: If air pressure in braking system tanks is excessively high, the driver must refrain from using the brakes and rely more on the retarder.

source.text_it: Il conducente che verifica che vi sia un'avaria di uno dei due circuiti dell'impianto frenante, deve arrestarsi quanto prima in condizioni di sicurezza

records.localized_text: A driver who detects failure of one of the two braking circuits must stop safely as soon as possible.

source.text_it: L'eccessiva pressione d'aria nei serbatoi dell'impianto frenante è indicata dal manometro presente sul cruscotto

records.localized_text: Excessive air pressure in braking system tanks is indicated by the dashboard pressure gauge.

source.text_it: In caso di scarsa pressione dell'aria dei serbatoi dell'impianto frenante, è opportuno agire sul pedale del freno per far salire la pressione

records.localized_text: If air pressure in braking system tanks is low, it is advisable to press the brake pedal to increase pressure.

source.text_it: In caso di malfunzionamento del distributore duplex è opportuno marciare con il motore ad alto numero di giri

records.localized_text: If the duplex valve malfunctions, it is advisable to drive with the engine at high revolutions.

source.text_it: L'indicazione di un eccesso di pressione dell'aria nei serbatoi dell'impianto frenante può essere causata da un difettoso funzionamento del gruppo di regolazione e controllo

records.localized_text: Excessive air pressure indicated in braking system tanks may be caused by a faulty regulation and control unit.

source.text_it: Il limitatore di velocità è obbligatorio per tutti i veicoli delle categorie M2, M3, N2, N3

records.localized_text: A speed limiter is mandatory for all category M2, M3, N2 and N3 vehicles.

source.text_it: Il limitatore di velocità è obbligatorio per tutti gli autocarri con massa a pieno carico superiore alle 3,5 t

records.localized_text: A speed limiter is mandatory for all trucks with a fully laden mass over 3.5 tonnes.

source.text_it: Il limitatore di velocità è obbligatorio per tutti i veicoli cisterna di massa autorizzata maggiore di 12 t, a prescindere dalla loro data di immatricolazione

records.localized_text: A speed limiter is mandatory for all tank vehicles with an authorised mass over 12 tonnes, regardless of registration date.

source.text_it: Il limitatore di velocità è obbligatorio per tutti i veicoli cisterna immatricolati dopo il 31 dicembre 1987, a prescindere dalla loro massa massima autorizzata

records.localized_text: A speed limiter is mandatory for all tank vehicles registered after 31 December 1987, regardless of maximum authorised mass.

source.text_it: Il limitatore di velocità è obbligatorio per i veicoli delle categorie M2, M3 e consigliato per i veicoli delle categorie N2, N3

records.localized_text: A speed limiter is mandatory for category M2 and M3 vehicles and recommended for N2 and N3 vehicles.

source.text_it: Il cambio di velocità è necessario al fine di ottimizzare l'utilizzo del motore in funzione della velocità del veicolo, della pendenza della strada, della resistenza aerodinamica e del carico

records.localized_text: The gearbox optimises engine use according to vehicle speed, road gradient, aerodynamic resistance and load.

source.text_it: Il motore deve essere utilizzato ad un regime (giri/minuto) compreso tra quello di coppia minima e quello di potenza massima in cui si ottengono il migliore rendimento e il minor consumo specifico di carburante

records.localized_text: The engine must operate between the minimum-torque and maximum-power speeds, where best efficiency and lowest specific fuel consumption are obtained.

source.text_it: Nelle discese ripide bisogna impiegare le marce basse per sfruttare l'effetto frenante del motore

records.localized_text: On steep descents, low gears must be used to exploit engine braking.

source.text_it: Il cambio di velocità consente di aumentare la forza di trazione alle alte velocità

records.localized_text: The gearbox increases tractive force at high speeds.

source.text_it: Nelle salite percorse con il veicolo carico non si devono mai usare le marce ridotte

records.localized_text: When climbing with a loaded vehicle, low-range gears must never be used.

source.text_it: Nelle salite percorse con il veicolo carico occorre una marcia bassa, che corrisponde una forza di trazione maggiore

records.localized_text: When climbing with a loaded vehicle, a low gear corresponding to greater tractive force is needed.

source.text_it: In discesa, l'uso di una marcia bassa consente di sfruttare l'effetto frenante del motore

records.localized_text: Downhill, a low gear allows engine braking to be used.

source.text_it: In discesa l'uso di una marcia bassa (ridotta) aumenta gli spazi di frenatura

records.localized_text: Downhill, using a low gear increases braking distance.

source.text_it: In ogni condizione di marcia occorre mantenere un numero di giri del motore prossimo a quello di minor consumo specifico

records.localized_text: In all driving conditions, engine speed should remain close to that of lowest specific fuel consumption.

source.text_it: Nelle salite percorse con il veicolo carico è opportuno mantenere il motore a un numero di giri compreso nell'intervallo ottimale indicato dal contagiri

records.localized_text: When climbing loaded, it is advisable to keep engine speed within the optimal range indicated by the tachometer.

source.text_it: Inserendo una marcia più alta diminuisce il coefficiente di penetrazione aerodinamica (CX)

records.localized_text: Selecting a higher gear reduces the aerodynamic drag coefficient (CX).

source.text_it: Nelle salite percorse con il veicolo carico è opportuno cambiare la marcia quando l'indicatore del contagiri esce dall'intervallo ottimale

records.localized_text: When climbing loaded, it is advisable to change gear when the tachometer leaves the optimal range.

source.text_it: In discesa l'uso di una marcia bassa (ridotta) consente di stabilizzare la velocità del veicolo

records.localized_text: Downhill, using a low gear helps stabilise vehicle speed.

rows.text: The secondary brake can stop the vehicle if the service brake fails; it may use the part of the system that remains operational.
evidence: https://eur-lex.europa.eu/legal-content/EN/TXT/PDF/?uri=OJ%3AL_202600746 — UN Regulation 13, published 2026, §§5.1.2.2 and 5.2.1.2.6: secondary or unaffected service braking can halt a vehicle after service-brake failure, subject to prescribed performance; approval provisions, not a substitute for maintenance.

https://www.icbc.com/assets/en/3ZRN0guL3MkbgvZvTCBfbu/drive_commercial_veh_full.pdf — ICBC Driving Commercial Vehicles, chapter 8, compressor/governor, reservoir safety valve, foot valve, dual circuits and pressure gauges (printed pp.150–155, 166): governor regulates charging, gauge shows reservoir pressure, and a remaining circuit can provide reduced braking after the other fails; a malfunction requires service.

rows.text: A retarder does not repair a pressure fault or replace the service brake. Stop safely and have the system checked.
evidence: https://www.icbc.com/assets/en/3ZRN0guL3MkbgvZvTCBfbu/drive_commercial_veh_full.pdf — ICBC Driving Commercial Vehicles, chapter 8, compressor/governor, reservoir safety valve, foot valve, dual circuits and pressure gauges (printed pp.150–155, 166): governor regulates charging, gauge shows reservoir pressure, and a remaining circuit can provide reduced braking after the other fails; a malfunction requires service.

https://eur-lex.europa.eu/legal-content/EN/TXT/PDF/?uri=OJ%3AL_202600746 — UN Regulation 13, published 2026, §§5.1.2.2 and 5.2.1.2.6: secondary or unaffected service braking can halt a vehicle after service-brake failure, subject to prescribed performance; approval provisions, not a substitute for maintenance.

rows.text: A working circuit can provide residual braking, but the system is faulty. Stop safely as soon as possible and have it checked.
evidence: https://www.icbc.com/assets/en/3ZRN0guL3MkbgvZvTCBfbu/drive_commercial_veh_full.pdf — ICBC Driving Commercial Vehicles, chapter 8, compressor/governor, reservoir safety valve, foot valve, dual circuits and pressure gauges (printed pp.150–155, 166): governor regulates charging, gauge shows reservoir pressure, and a remaining circuit can provide reduced braking after the other fails; a malfunction requires service.

https://eur-lex.europa.eu/legal-content/EN/TXT/PDF/?uri=OJ%3AL_202600746 — UN Regulation 13, published 2026, §§5.1.2.2 and 5.2.1.2.6: secondary or unaffected service braking can halt a vehicle after service-brake failure, subject to prescribed performance; approval provisions, not a substitute for maintenance.

rows.text: The pressure gauge shows reservoir pressure. Comparing its reading with the normal range can reveal excessive pressure too.
evidence: https://www.icbc.com/assets/en/3ZRN0guL3MkbgvZvTCBfbu/drive_commercial_veh_full.pdf — ICBC Driving Commercial Vehicles, chapter 8, compressor/governor, reservoir safety valve, foot valve, dual circuits and pressure gauges (printed pp.150–155, 166): governor regulates charging, gauge shows reservoir pressure, and a remaining circuit can provide reduced braking after the other fails; a malfunction requires service.

rows.text: Pressing the pedal consumes air rather than filling the reservoirs. The compressor restores pressure; if it does not recover, have the fault checked.
evidence: https://www.icbc.com/assets/en/3ZRN0guL3MkbgvZvTCBfbu/drive_commercial_veh_full.pdf — ICBC Driving Commercial Vehicles, chapter 8, compressor/governor, reservoir safety valve, foot valve, dual circuits and pressure gauges (printed pp.150–155, 166): governor regulates charging, gauge shows reservoir pressure, and a remaining circuit can provide reduced braking after the other fails; a malfunction requires service.

rows.text: The dual brake valve controls service braking. Raising engine speed does not repair it: stop safely and have the fault checked.
evidence: https://www.icbc.com/assets/en/3ZRN0guL3MkbgvZvTCBfbu/drive_commercial_veh_full.pdf — ICBC Driving Commercial Vehicles, chapter 8, compressor/governor, reservoir safety valve, foot valve, dual circuits and pressure gauges (printed pp.150–155, 166): governor regulates charging, gauge shows reservoir pressure, and a remaining circuit can provide reduced braking after the other fails; a malfunction requires service.

https://eur-lex.europa.eu/legal-content/EN/TXT/PDF/?uri=OJ%3AL_202600746 — UN Regulation 13, published 2026, §§5.1.2.2 and 5.2.1.2.6: secondary or unaffected service braking can halt a vehicle after service-brake failure, subject to prescribed performance; approval provisions, not a substitute for maintenance.

rows.text: The governor controls the compressor to keep pressure within its limits. A fault can prevent charging from stopping and cause excess pressure.
evidence: https://www.icbc.com/assets/en/3ZRN0guL3MkbgvZvTCBfbu/drive_commercial_veh_full.pdf — ICBC Driving Commercial Vehicles, chapter 8, compressor/governor, reservoir safety valve, foot valve, dual circuits and pressure gauges (printed pp.150–155, 166): governor regulates charging, gauge shows reservoir pressure, and a remaining circuit can provide reduced braking after the other fails; a malfunction requires service.

rows.text: The quiz marks this TRUE: speed limiters are required for the relevant M2, M3, N2 and N3 categories. The rules also distinguish vehicles by registration date and contain specific exclusions; “all” does not remove those conditions.
evidence: https://eur-lex.europa.eu/legal-content/EN/TXT/?uri=CELEX:01992L0006-20021204 — Directive 92/6/EEC as consolidated on 4 December 2002, Articles 1–4 and 6: M2/M3 and N2/N3 rules, registration and emissions phase-in and stated exclusions. https://rivistagiuridica.aci.it/fileadmin/Documenti/1083_03.pdf — 2005 Italian ministry circular, §2: identifies the relevant categories and different vehicle-registration/emissions requirements, with construction-speed exception; historical context, not a claim that temporary exceptions remain current.

rows.text: The quiz marks this TRUE: trucks over 3.5 tonnes fall within N2 or N3, categories covered by speed-limiter rules. Registration dates and specified exclusions also matter, so weight alone is not sufficient.
evidence: https://eur-lex.europa.eu/legal-content/EN/TXT/?uri=CELEX:01992L0006-20021204 — Directive 92/6/EEC as consolidated on 4 December 2002, Articles 1–4 and 6: M2/M3 and N2/N3 rules, registration and emissions phase-in and stated exclusions. Directly inspected exact 5-page local PDF SHA-256 90f8516d7352a0ccfd7e0cfb78185f407c06cf9f6b5555b7d3a41f16cacf8ea0, pp.3–4; historical EU text, not a claim of unchanged current national implementation.

rows.text: For these vehicles mass alone is not enough: the speed limiter provisions also specify registration dates and conditions of application.
evidence: https://rivistagiuridica.aci.it/fileadmin/Documenti/1083_03.pdf — Italian ministry circular 2005, §2: registration dates, emissions approvals, category and construction-speed exception for speed-limiter installation; historical application.

https://gazzettaufficiale.biz/atti/2005/20050050/05A01775.htm — 19 November 2004 Italian transposition decree, Art.1 amending Articles 1–4 of the 1994 decree: categories, speed settings and registration-date rules.

rows.text: The date alone is not enough: the requirement also depends on the vehicle category and mass and other applicable conditions.
evidence: https://rivistagiuridica.aci.it/fileadmin/Documenti/1083_03.pdf — Italian ministry circular 2005, §2: registration dates, emissions approvals, category and construction-speed exception for speed-limiter installation; historical application.

https://gazzettaufficiale.biz/atti/2005/20050050/05A01775.htm — 19 November 2004 Italian transposition decree, Art.1 amending Articles 1–4 of the 1994 decree: categories, speed settings and registration-date rules.

rows.text: A speed limiter is also mandatory for categories N2 and N3 under the applicable conditions; it is not merely recommended.
evidence: https://rivistagiuridica.aci.it/fileadmin/Documenti/1083_03.pdf — Italian ministry circular 2005, §2: registration dates, emissions approvals, category and construction-speed exception for speed-limiter installation; historical application.

https://gazzettaufficiale.biz/atti/2005/20050050/05A01775.htm — 19 November 2004 Italian transposition decree, Art.1 amending Articles 1–4 of the 1994 decree: categories, speed settings and registration-date rules.

rows.text: Gear ratios adapt engine speed and wheel force to vehicle speed and the resistance to overcome, which varies with gradient, load and air.
evidence: https://www.volvotrucks.com/en-en/news-stories/stories/2016/apr/crawler-gears.html — Volvo Trucks: low crawler gearing improves starting a heavily laden truck on an incline; gear reduction increases available driveline torque in this example.

https://assets.publishing.service.gov.uk/government/uploads/system/uploads/attachment_data/file/377668/national-standard-for-driving-lorries.pdf — DVSA National standard for driving lorries, element 2.2.3: gear selection should match speed, gradients, load and conditions.

rows.text: Minimum torque is not the reference. To save fuel, select the gear that keeps the engine in its specified efficient range.
evidence: https://movingon.blog.gov.uk/2019/09/17/6-tips-to-improve-your-vehicles-fuel-efficiency/, DVSA: operating in tachometer green band saves fuel; select right gear downhill.

https://www.volvotrucks.com/en-en/news-stories/stories/2016/apr/crawler-gears.html — Volvo Trucks: low crawler gearing improves starting a heavily laden truck on an incline; gear reduction increases available driveline torque in this example.

https://assets.publishing.service.gov.uk/government/uploads/system/uploads/attachment_data/file/377668/national-standard-for-driving-lorries.pdf — DVSA National standard for driving lorries, element 2.2.3: gear selection should match speed, gradients, load and conditions.

rows.text: A low gear increases engine braking and helps control speed without relying continuously on the service brakes.
evidence: https://en.powys.gov.uk/article/4711/Winter-driving-advice?ccp=true, Powys County Council: use a low gear downhill to avoid excess braking.

https://www.volvotrucks.com/en-en/news-stories/stories/2016/apr/crawler-gears.html — Volvo Trucks: low crawler gearing improves starting a heavily laden truck on an incline; gear reduction increases available driveline torque in this example.

https://assets.publishing.service.gov.uk/government/uploads/system/uploads/attachment_data/file/377668/national-standard-for-driving-lorries.pdf — DVSA National standard for driving lorries, element 2.2.3: gear selection should match speed, gradients, load and conditions.

rows.text: At the same engine torque, a low gear multiplies wheel torque more than a high gear, providing greater tractive force.
evidence: https://www.volvotrucks.com/en-en/news-stories/stories/2016/apr/crawler-gears.html — Volvo Trucks: low crawler gearing improves starting a heavily laden truck on an incline; gear reduction increases available driveline torque in this example.

https://assets.publishing.service.gov.uk/government/uploads/system/uploads/attachment_data/file/377668/national-standard-for-driving-lorries.pdf — DVSA National standard for driving lorries, element 2.2.3: gear selection should match speed, gradients, load and conditions.

rows.text: Climbing, especially when loaded, may require a low gear: the higher ratio helps produce more force at the wheels.
evidence: https://www.volvotrucks.com/en-en/news-stories/stories/2016/apr/crawler-gears.html — Volvo Trucks: low crawler gearing improves starting a heavily laden truck on an incline; gear reduction increases available driveline torque in this example.

https://assets.publishing.service.gov.uk/government/uploads/system/uploads/attachment_data/file/377668/national-standard-for-driving-lorries.pdf — DVSA National standard for driving lorries, element 2.2.3: gear selection should match speed, gradients, load and conditions.

rows.text: A low gear multiplies wheel torque more, providing more force to overcome the resistance of a loaded climb.
evidence: https://www.volvotrucks.com/en-en/news-stories/stories/2016/apr/crawler-gears.html — Volvo Trucks: low crawler gearing improves starting a heavily laden truck on an incline; gear reduction increases available driveline torque in this example.

https://assets.publishing.service.gov.uk/government/uploads/system/uploads/attachment_data/file/377668/national-standard-for-driving-lorries.pdf — DVSA National standard for driving lorries, element 2.2.3: gear selection should match speed, gradients, load and conditions.

rows.text: In a low gear the wheels turn the engine faster: its resistance helps slow the vehicle downhill.
evidence: https://assets.publishing.service.gov.uk/government/uploads/system/uploads/attachment_data/file/377668/national-standard-for-driving-lorries.pdf, DVSA National standard for driving lorries, element 2.2.3: choose appropriate gear for speed and conditions, especially gradients and load.
https://en.powys.gov.uk/article/4711/Winter-driving-advice?ccp=true, Powys County Council: use a low gear downhill to avoid excess braking.

rows.text: A low gear promotes engine braking and helps contain downhill speed; it does not in itself increase braking distance.
evidence: https://assets.publishing.service.gov.uk/government/uploads/system/uploads/attachment_data/file/377668/national-standard-for-driving-lorries.pdf, DVSA National standard for driving lorries, element 2.2.3: choose appropriate gear for speed and conditions, especially gradients and load.
https://en.powys.gov.uk/article/4711/Winter-driving-advice?ccp=true, Powys County Council: use a low gear downhill to avoid excess braking.

rows.text: For economical driving, aim for the engine’s efficient speed range, choosing a gear suited to conditions without compromising control.
evidence: https://assets.publishing.service.gov.uk/government/uploads/system/uploads/attachment_data/file/377668/national-standard-for-driving-lorries.pdf, DVSA National standard for driving lorries, element 2.2.3: choose appropriate gear for speed and conditions, especially gradients and load.
https://movingon.blog.gov.uk/2019/09/17/6-tips-to-improve-your-vehicles-fuel-efficiency/, DVSA: operating in tachometer green band saves fuel; select right gear downhill.

rows.text: The tachometer’s optimal range helps select a gear that keeps the engine efficient while dealing with the effort of the climb.
evidence: https://assets.publishing.service.gov.uk/government/uploads/system/uploads/attachment_data/file/377668/national-standard-for-driving-lorries.pdf, DVSA National standard for driving lorries, element 2.2.3: choose appropriate gear for speed and conditions, especially gradients and load.
https://movingon.blog.gov.uk/2019/09/17/6-tips-to-improve-your-vehicles-fuel-efficiency/, DVSA: operating in tachometer green band saves fuel; select right gear downhill.

rows.text: The gear ratio changes engine speed, not the vehicle’s aerodynamic shape. The drag coefficient does not simply fall when a higher gear is selected.
evidence: https://www1.grc.nasa.gov/beginners-guide-to-aeronautics/drag-coefficient/, NASA Glenn: drag coefficient characterizes shape, inclination and flow conditions; gear selection is not itself a change of shape.

rows.text: If engine speed leaves the optimal range, changing gear helps return it to the useful range and maintain the traction needed uphill.
evidence: https://assets.publishing.service.gov.uk/government/uploads/system/uploads/attachment_data/file/377668/national-standard-for-driving-lorries.pdf, DVSA National standard for driving lorries, element 2.2.3: choose appropriate gear for speed and conditions, especially gradients and load.
https://movingon.blog.gov.uk/2019/09/17/6-tips-to-improve-your-vehicles-fuel-efficiency/, DVSA: operating in tachometer green band saves fuel; select right gear downhill.

rows.text: Downhill, a low gear uses engine resistance to help contain and stabilize speed; the brakes remain available when needed.
evidence: https://assets.publishing.service.gov.uk/government/uploads/system/uploads/attachment_data/file/377668/national-standard-for-driving-lorries.pdf, DVSA National standard for driving lorries, element 2.2.3: choose appropriate gear for speed and conditions, especially gradients and load.
https://en.powys.gov.uk/article/4711/Winter-driving-advice?ccp=true, Powys County Council: use a low gear downhill to avoid excess braking.
